attentionPathList.summary:
Create a new MT4 symbol.
Set CentralizedConfigurationSystem.Application.Dtos.MT4.Symbols.CreateMt4SymbolRequest.IsDuplicate to true when the user is duplicating an existing symbol
via the detail page — Duplicate permission is checked instead of Create, and the audit log records
a Duplicate action referencing CentralizedConfigurationSystem.Application.Dtos.MT4.Symbols.CreateMt4SymbolRequest.FromSymbolName as the source.

Create a single MT5 symbol.
Set CentralizedConfigurationSystem.Application.Dtos.MT5.Symbols.Requests.CreateMt5SymbolRequest.IsDuplicate to true when the user is duplicating an existing symbol
via the detail page — Duplicate permission is checked instead of Create, and the audit log records
a Duplicate action referencing CentralizedConfigurationSystem.Application.Dtos.MT5.Symbols.Requests.CreateMt5SymbolRequest.FromSymbolName as the source.

Asynchronously transfer (clone) MT4 managers to one or more target servers via background job.
Each (manager × target server) combination is processed independently; returns immediately
with a job id — poll `GET /api/v5/jobs/{jobId}` for progress + results.

Asynchronously transfer (overwrite) MT4 manager settings to one or more target servers
via background job. Update-only: a manager with the same Login AND Name must already
exist in the target's Manager List — no new manager is created.

Asynchronously transfer (overwrite) MT4 trading-account settings to one or more target
servers via background job. Update-only: an account with the same Login AND Name must
already exist on the target — no new account is created.
